title: 6.12 What Time Does It Leave?
unit_outcome: Name places in town, say how you travel and where places are, ask for and give directions, and read bus and train times.
goal: Ask Wann fährt der Zug ab? and answer Der Zug fährt um neun Uhr ab.
grammar_function: Wann fährt/kommt + vehicle + ab/an? Vehicle + fährt um ... Uhr ab.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say when buses and trains leave and arrive.
